explanation: Almost always 0; it spikes to about 9-10 only at D2 when the agent chose a1 and rarely reached S2, late in the episode (trial 93 or later), and the previous trial was rewarded (usually after a run of rewarded a1 to S1 trials). The same a1-rare-to-S2 event earlier in the episode (before about trial 90) or after an unrewarded trial stays at 0, and so do all D1 and GO steps and all a2 choices.
